ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Figure 5 is the movement path map of Typhoon Morakot. Taiwan Island is located in the middle-right part of the figure. The typhoon path is represented by a line and time labels, and labels such as “0714,” “0814,” and “0914” can be seen in the figure. The leader line of the “0714” label points to the typhoon center position near southern Taiwan; Kaohsiung is located on the south-western side of Taiwan Island, so according to the figure, at 14:00 on August 7, Kaohsiung was roughly located near the north side or northwest side of the “0714” typhoon center. Reasoning: Morakot was located in the Northern Hemisphere, and the near-surface airflow of a typhoon rotates counterclockwise around the low-pressure center. Combining Kaohsiung’s position relative to the typhoon center on the north side/northwest side, it can be judged that the wind direction there mainly had a component blowing from the west side, so the credible wind direction was westerly wind.

raw_record.question_text: According to the “Morakot movement path map” (Figure 5) <image1>, at 14:00 on August 7, what was the wind direction in Kaohsiung, a city in southern Taiwan?

method.method_draft: First read the map to identify the 8月7日14时 typhoon center labeled 0714 near southern Taiwan. Then compare Kaohsiung’s position in southern Taiwan with that center: Kaohsiung lies to the north/northwest of the center. Apply the Northern Hemisphere typhoon counterclockwise circulation rule; at a point north of the low center, the wind vector is mainly eastward, meaning it comes from the west. Therefore the credible wind direction is 偏西风.

raw_record.original_question: 据《莫拉克移动路径图》(图5) <image1>，8月7日14时台湾南部城市高雄的风向是什么？
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: Figure 5 is the movement path map of Typhoon Morakot. Taiwan Island is located in the middle-right part of the figure. The typhoon path is represented by a line and time labels, and labels such as “0714,” “0814,” and “0914” can be seen in the figure. The leader line of the “0714” label points to the typhoon center position near southern Taiwan; Kaohsiung is located on the south-western side of Taiwan Island, so according to the figure, at 14:00 on August 7, Kaohsiung was roughly located near the north side or northwest side of the “0714” typhoon center. Reasoning: Morakot was located in the Northern Hemisphere, and the near-surface airflow of a typhoon rotates counterclockwise around the low-pressure center. Combining Kaohsiung’s position relative to the typhoon center on the north side/northwest side, it can be judged that the wind direction there mainly had a component blowing from the west side, so the credible wind direction was westerly wind.
